_source: Real domochi menu from domochitreats.com (Square Online store), fetched 2026-10-30. Names and prices are exact. Game fields (glaze style, colors, unlockDay) are game design, not from the shop. Drizzles and the cookie on cookie butter are from the A-frame sign photo Kumar shared (2026-10-30). Glaze speckles (strawberry seeds, cookie crumbs, nut bits) are game art detail.

flavors.name: strawberry
flavors.description: bright, fruity strawberry glaze on our light and chewy, pull-apart mochi ring. sweet, simple and pretty in pink.

flavors.name: cookies & cream
flavors.description: sweet cookies-and-cream glaze topped with crushed chocolate cookies on our chewy, pull-apart mochi ring. a classic combo, done the domochi way.

flavors.name: chocolate hazelnut
flavors.description: rich, nutty chocolate hazelnut glaze on our chewy, pull-apart mochi ring. a chocolate lover's dream, made fresh daily.

flavors.name: fruity cereal
flavors.description: saturday-morning nostalgia in donut form. sweet glaze and colorful fruity cereal crunch on our chewy, pull-apart mochi ring.

flavors.name: cookie butter
flavors.description: sweet, warmly spiced cookie butter glaze on our chewy, pull-apart mochi ring. cozy, caramel-y and seriously addictive.

flavors.name: beignet
flavors.description: a louisiana classic, reimagined. our chewy, pull-apart mochi ring finished beignet-style with a snowy dusting of powdered sugar. light, fluffy and made fresh daily.

boxes.name: the trio
boxes.description: can't pick just one? choose any 3 mochi donuts.

boxes.name: the flight
boxes.description: half a dozen mochi donuts, and you pick every flavor.

boxes.name: the domochi box
boxes.description: a full dozen mochi donuts, and you pick every flavor.
